title: mauricioroza/gencorr pipeline parameters
description: Global (LDSC) and local (LAVA) genetic correlation from GWAS summary statistics, with a pluggable method interface

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet (CSV): one row per trait with columns id, sumstats [, n, n_cases, n_controls, pop_prev, colmap, label].
input.help_text: See docs/usage.md. Binary traits need n_cases and n_controls; add pop_prev to also get liability-scale h2.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

methods.help_text: Available: ldsc (global rg), lava (local rg). New methods are added via the registry in subworkflows/local/utils_nfcore_gencorr_pipeline.

pair_mode.help_text: all: every pair of samplesheet traits. target: --targets against every other trait (BigaGWAS 'one vs group'). pairs: exactly the pairs in --pairs.

targets.description: pair_mode target: comma-separated trait IDs to test against all other traits.

pairs.description: pair_mode pairs: CSV/TSV with header trait1,trait2.

save_harmonized.description: Publish the harmonized summary statistics (otherwise only their QC reports).

save_intermediates.description: Publish munged LDSC files and per-chunk LAVA tables.

harmonization_options.title: Harmonization options
harmonization_options.description: How raw summary statistics are converted to the shared format.

z_priority.description: Order in which the signed Z-score is derived: z (Z column), p (P + sign of effect), beta_se (BETA/SE).
z_priority.help_text: Default 'z,p,beta_se' matches what LDSC munge and LAVA do with raw files (and what BigaGWAS fed them).

drop_ambiguous.description: Remove strand-ambiguous A/T and C/G SNPs before any method.
drop_ambiguous.help_text: Off by default to stay comparable with running LDSC/LAVA directly. LDSC munge always removes them for LDSC.

min_info.description: Remove variants with imputation INFO <= this value, for all methods. 0 = off (default).
min_info.help_text: Same rule as LDSC munge (which uses 0.9 for LDSC only). Variants without an INFO value are kept. Ignored, with a warning in the QC report, for files without an INFO column.

min_maf.description: Remove variants with minor allele frequency <= this value, for all methods. 0 = off (default).
min_maf.help_text: MAF is taken from a MAF column, or computed as min(EAF, 1-EAF). Variants without a value are kept. Ignored, with a warning in the QC report, for files with neither column.

ldsc_ld.description: Directory with LDSC reference LD scores (e.g. eur_w_ld_chr/).

ldsc_w_ld.description: Directory with regression-weight LD scores. Default: same as --ldsc_ld.

ldsc_ld_prefix.description: File prefix inside the LD-score directory ('' for eur_w_ld_chr, whose files are 1.l2.ldscore.gz ...).

ldsc_ld_split_by_chr.description: LD scores are split by chromosome (--ref-ld-chr). Set false for a single file set (--ref-ld).

ldsc_merge_alleles.description: SNP list passed to munge_sumstats.py --merge-alleles (normally w_hm3.snplist).
ldsc_merge_alleles.help_text: Strongly recommended: without it, LDSC fails a pair when an rsID has different alleles in the two traits.

ldsc_rg_batch_size.description: Maximum number of traits compared with one trait1 in a single ldsc --rg call. Batching does not change estimates.

lava_ref.description: LD reference prefix: PLINK (<prefix>.bed/.bim/.fam) or LAVA LD format (e.g. lava-ukb-v1.1).
lava_ref.help_text: For European-ancestry data the LAVA authors recommend their UK Biobank LD reference over 1000 Genomes (1000G can inflate type I error).

lava_loci.description: Locus definition file (LOC CHR START STOP). Default: LAVA's 2,495 GRCh37 blocks.

lava_overlap.description: Sample-overlap correction: 'ldsc' (from LDSC intercepts), 'none', or a path to a matrix file.

lava_snp_set.description: Which SNPs a pair is analysed on.
lava_snp_set.help_text: pairwise: SNPs shared by the two traits (result independent of other traits). joint: SNPs shared by all traits in the run (LAVA multi-phenotype behaviour, as in BigaGWAS batches).

lava_loci_per_chunk.description: Loci per LAVA task. Smaller = more parallel tasks. Does not change results.

lava_univ_thresh.description: Run the bivariate test only when both traits have local univariate p below this.
lava_univ_thresh.help_text: LAVA default 0.05. The LAVA authors suggest a Bonferroni-type threshold (e.g. 0.05/2495) for genome-wide screens.

lava_adap_thresh.description: p-value thresholds at which LAVA increases simulation iterations (1e4 -> 1e5 -> 1e6).

lava_param_lim.description: Estimates beyond +/- this bound are set to NA (LAVA param.lim).

lava_seed.description: Base random seed; each (locus, pair) gets a seed derived from it.

lava_snp_list.description: Restrict LAVA to the SNP IDs in this list (first column; e.g. w_hm3.snplist). Default: all SNPs.
lava_snp_list.help_text: Reproduces BigaGWAS, which runs LAVA on HapMap3 SNPs only. Fewer SNPs = more robust to imputation quality and faster, but less information and some loci become sparse. Recorded in the results ('extra.snp_set').

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
